% ─── Abbreviations (footnote on first use) ──────────────────────────────────
% Defines \defabbr{key}{SHORT}{Long Form} and \abbr{key}
% First use: prints "SHORT" with a footnote "SHORT: Long Form"
% Subsequent uses: prints "SHORT" only
\newcommand{\defabbr}[3]{%
  \expandafter\newif\csname if@abbr@#1@used\endcsname
  \expandafter\newcommand\csname @abbr@short@#1\endcsname{#2}%
  \expandafter\newcommand\csname @abbr@long@#1\endcsname{#3}%
}
\newcommand{\abbr}[1]{%
  \ifcsname @abbr@short@#1\endcsname
    \csname @abbr@short@#1\endcsname%
    \csname if@abbr@#1@used\endcsname\else
      \footnote{\csname @abbr@short@#1\endcsname: \csname @abbr@long@#1\endcsname}%
      \global\expandafter\csname @abbr@#1@usedtrue\endcsname
    \fi
  \else
    \textbf{??#1??}%
  \fi
}
\newcommand{\abbrfull}[1]{%
  \csname @abbr@long@#1\endcsname\ (\csname @abbr@short@#1\endcsname)%
}
\newcommand{\abbrshort}[1]{\csname @abbr@short@#1\endcsname}
\newcommand{\abbrlong}[1]{\csname @abbr@long@#1\endcsname}
